basics.name: Jay S
basics.label: Product & Technology Leader
basics.summary: Technology & Product Leader with 12+ years of experience bridging the gap between complex enterprise engineering and business strategy. Expert in open-source enterprise stacks, RegTech/tax compliance, and AI-native product development. Proven track record of architecting scalable platforms for regulated markets, leading cross-functional teams (engineering, design, GTM), and driving cost-efficient delivery through open-source adoption. Pioneering AI-native product methodologies that combine rapid LLM-based validation with enterprise-scale execution. Experienced in zero-to-one launches, international market expansion, and legacy system modernization.

work.name: Covai Labs
work.summary: Spearheaded the technical strategy, product execution, and infrastructure modernization for a legacy telecom AI platform (Client: Skyvera). Managed a $2M+ vendor consolidation initiative and achieved an 85% technical debt reduction while maintaining 99.9% uptime.
highlights: Infrastructure Modernization & Cost Optimization: Championed Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration, eliminating $2M+ annual licensing costs and reinvesting in platform reliability improvements and customer-facing innovation while maintaining 99.9% uptime.

Platform Strategy & Technical Debt Reduction: Defined unified product vision to consolidate 11 fragmented software versions into a unified platform architecture, reducing technical debt by 85% and enabling faster feature iteration and release velocity.
AI-Enabled Service Operations: Designed and launched self-service support portals with embedded RAG AI agents, automating release note distribution and deflecting 40%+ of routine support tickets.

Legacy System Lifecycle Management: Formulated and executed a version deprecation strategy for an SMS center product suite, seamlessly migrating clients to a single supported infrastructure within existing SLAs and contract constraints, significantly reducing engineering load.

Cross-Functional IT Leadership: Operated as the central technical liaison coordinating between engineering (50+), DevOps, commercial, and customer support teams, authoring detailed technical specifications and establishing API scalability and security standards.

AI Infrastructure Innovation & Launch: Ideated, architected, and launched AI-native products including Kandy Notetaker (UCaaS integration for call transcription, diarization, and AI-driven insights) and Lithium Defender (LLM-based phishing detection), extending the lifecycle of legacy UCaaS systems and establishing secure, high-value ARR from existing legacy customer bases.

IT Process Automation & Productivity: Championed productivity tooling for internal teams (Markdown, LaTeX, Marp) and set up self-hosted RAG tools (Cinnamon/kotaemon) for automated documentation workflows, later migrating to ephor.ai and NotebookLM to streamline knowledge management.
Product Discovery: Accelerated time-to-market by 60% by prototyping LLM concepts (Claude Code, Cursor) to validate user value before engineering commitment.
Release Engineering & Standards: Established SemVer (Major.Minor.Patch) versioning standards across legacy and modern assets to align release engineering cycles with product maturity.

Independent Contract / MVP Delivery: Managed the end-to-end development lifecycle for two MVP products (Live Shopping application, Garage Management Portal). Translated stakeholder needs into user stories and defined technical architecture (React.js, Node.js, MongoDB) with precise API specifications for rapid market entry.

work.name: Taxilla IT Solutions
work.summary: Owned the product lifecycle for a Fintech/RegTech SaaS platform, driving international expansion and compliance.
highlights: RegTech Strategy & Global Expansion: Led the product roadmap for entering stringent international markets (KSA, UAE), ensuring the platform met complex data sovereignty and cryptographic signing requirements.

Platform Scalability: Collaborated with architects to redesign a core high-throughput transaction engine for reconciliation across Banking, Insurance, and E-commerce, supporting a 350% increase in volume.

Customer Success & MVP: Built MVP solutions for each industry use-case, personally conducting capability demos for prospective leads and onboarding key accounts for initial User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
User Adoption & Growth: Achieved an 80% increase in platform adoption and a 350% increase in web traffic by conducting user research to identify friction points and redesigning the onboarding flow.
Cross-Functional Enablement: Reduced internal team ramp-up time by 50% by establishing a structured knowledge framework that aligned Inside Sales, Support, Development, and QA teams.
GTM & Sales Enablement: Spearheaded marketing initiatives, lead generation, and conducted technical sales presentations and POC demos, accelerating the enterprise sales cycle.

work.name: ValueLabs
work.summary: Led growth-focused product initiatives and zero-to-one digital transformation for enterprise clients.
highlights: New Product Development: Led a zero-to-one digital transformation initiative, validating the concept through pilots and securing 3 enterprise contracts before General Availability (GA).
Cloud Solution Design: Collaborated with technical architects to define cloud-based solutions (AWS) that addressed complex business challenges, ensuring technical feasibility matched business goals.
Conversion Optimization: Partnered with design and engineering to implement ML-driven user flows, resulting in a 10% increase in conversion rates for client platforms.
Presales & Marketing: Led marketing efforts and cross-functional presales activities, delivering tailored sales presentations and technical product demos to secure enterprise contracts.

work.name: CIBI (Startup Incubator)
work.summary: MBA Internship with IIM Trichy. CIBI is a pre-incubation program supporting early-stage startup teams.
highlights: Startup Enablement: Advised and supported a cohort of 15 startup teams in the pre-incubation phase on market analysis, product development, and business strategy. Conducted comprehensive startup assessments, provided sector insights, and developed pitch materials.
Workshops & Training: Initiated and conducted educational sessions equipping incubatees with strategic frameworks and methodologies for successful business development.

work.name: IBM
work.summary: Architected IT automation scripts and incident response processes for large enterprise IT service operations.
highlights: Process Automation: Developed and deployed Python/Bash automation scripts that reduced service desk ticket resolution time by 30%, directly improving SLA adherence.
Incident Management: Managed incident triage and resolution workflows, collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure system reliability.
Knowledge Management: Architected a centralized knowledge repository for the team, streamlining daily operations, standardizing edge-case handling, and reducing onboarding time by 40%.

work.name: LightMass
work.summary: Led enterprise IT systems migration and operational support desk management.
highlights: Open Source Infrastructure Initiative: Initiated and executed a company-wide migration from unlicensed Windows environments to CentOS Linux,LibreOffice, and other OSS. This eliminated legal compliance risk, saved $50k+ in licensing fees, and reduced malware incidents to zero.
Performance Leadership: Managed a team of 18 agents, improving Service Level Agreement (SLA) delivery by 35% through rigorous data-driven performance metrics.

work.name: Sutherland
work.summary: Delivered high-performance technical support and security mitigation for enterprise clients.
highlights: Security Specialization: Diagnosed and removed complex rootkits and ransomware from compromised Windows endpoints, gathering critical threat signature data to refine McAfee's detection algorithms.
Performance Excellence: Exceeded performance targets by 120% for a major U.S. credit bureau client, maintaining high customer retention rates.

Knowledge Management: Spearheaded knowledge management initiatives, continuously updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and leading on-the-job training programs to accelerate onboarding and optimize team performance.

projects.name: Anthropic Performance Take-Home (AI Orchestration)
projects.description: Achieved a 113x performance speedup (147,734 to 1,307 cycles) on Anthropic's VLIW SIMD architecture take-home test purely through strategic orchestration of AI agents.
highlights: Orchestrated a multi-agent AI system (Claude, Qwen Coder, ACP) to optimize a complex VLIW SIMD kernel, reducing simulated execution cycles from 147,734 down to 1,307 (98.8% reduction)
Engineered iterative AI workflows utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for targeted research and Agent Collaboration Protocol (ACP) for dividing architecture, implementation, and coordination tasks

Implemented strict validation guardrails (read-only tests, atomic commits) to prevent AI hallucination and ensure optimization correctness during complex SIMD vectorization and VLIW instruction packing
Surpassed the Claude Opus 4.5 baseline benchmark (1,487 cycles) through human-guided AI architecture exploration and parameters tuning

projects.name: ResumeOps Engine
projects.description: A decoupled, schema-first AI microservice that transforms static professional data into targeted, ATS-optimized resumes with zero-hallucination guarantees.
highlights: Engineered a decoupled AI tailoring microservice using Python, FastAPI, and Prefect to automate ATS-optimized resume generation
Implemented strict schema validation using Pydantic and standardized data on the JSON Resume specification to ensure full data portability
Developed a token-efficient 'Resume Compression' algorithm and anti-hallucination guardrails, resulting in 100% factual accuracy across tailored outputs
Optimized delivery by building a local Puppeteer-based PDF rendering engine, eliminating external API dependencies and improving system reliability by 40%

projects.name: Safe LGBT Dating Platform
projects.description: Designed and prototyped a secure dating platform with integrated government-grade ID verification workflows to ensure user safety. Led product validation and scalability feasibility analysis.

projects.name: AI-Powered Relationship Counselor
projects.description: Conducted product discovery and architected an AI-powered relationship counseling prototype. Evaluated LLM capabilities in high-stakes conversational domains, concluding a comprehensive feasibility study on current model compliance limitations.

projects.name: AI Chat Export - Browser Extension
projects.description: A browser extension that exports AI conversations from web UIs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.) to markdown files. Published on Firefox Add-ons with thousands of users.
highlights: Designed and built a cross-platform browser extension (Firefox/Chrome) that captures and exports AI chat conversations from major LLM platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to clean, formatted markdown files
Implemented intelligent DOM parsing and mutation observers to reliably detect and extract conversation content across dynamic, single-page web applications with varying UI structures

Architected a modular export pipeline supporting multiple output formats with customizable templates, enabling users to preserve prompts, responses, metadata, and formatting in portable markdown files
Published on Mozilla Add-ons (Firefox) with strong user adoption and positive reviews, addressing a critical gap in AI workflow tooling for researchers, developers, and content creators
Engineered robust error handling and fallback strategies to maintain functionality across platform UI updates and varying network conditions
Optimized extension performance to handle large conversations with hundreds of messages while maintaining fast export speeds and minimal memory footprint

projects.name: Jay S. AI Clone (Digital Twin)
projects.description: Architected and deployed a highly customized AI portfolio platform using an agentic RAG pipeline and multi-model orchestration.
highlights: Multi-Model Orchestration: Integrated OpenRouter (IBM Granite), Google (Gemini 3.1 Live), and OpenAI (Embeddings) to create a low-latency, voice-first user experience
Agentic RAG: Engineered a custom retrieval system with Contextual Retrieval (using IBM Granite to pre-summarize chunks), achieving high-precision responses from career documentation
Voice-First Interaction: Implemented real-time voice mode with Turn-Detection, allowing users to talk directly to the AI 'Jay' as a professional ghostwriter
Observability: Integrated Langfuse for trace analysis and Microsoft Clarity for UX monitoring to continuously optimize model performance and user engagement

projects.name: Job-Ops Tailoring Workflow
projects.description: Open Source Contributor for Career-Ops / Job-Ops: Redesigned the resume tailoring workflow to streamline ATS optimization pipelines. Authored technical enhancements that were adopted upstream by the project maintainers, improving system architecture and data ingestion speeds.

projects.name: Free DNS Server Coimbatore
projects.description: Privacy-focused Public DNS Infrastructure: Designed and deployed a zero-logging public DNS resolver in Coimbatore to reduce latency for the local community. Integrated automated network-level adblocking and malware filtering using AdGuard Home, serving local DNS queries securely.
